objective: To calculate, per operational month, the route-based PR of every trucking company paid By Resources (Master KPI) from Master Route Percentage, the E-Catalogue Price per KM and the TMMIN Calendar ([Create PR]).
To submit all trucking companies of the operational month as one approval bundle with one PR Sequence ([Submit PR]); the bundle is approved / rejected together in PR Approval (no partial approval).
To show the abnormalities of each trucking company (missing data / price, validation errors) in the Status column and block the submission until they are corrected.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display and Creation Period (PC-01 to PC-03)

Parameters: Operational Month only (mandatory, PC-01; message no. 1). Default = system month + 1; the List Summary of all trucking companies is calculated on open. PR Creation Type, Logistics Partner and the System Master setting are not on the screen.
Authorization configuration: VPLD Staff and VPLD Section Head may submit PR; other users get view only (message no. 14).

Period: Month N+1 allowed (created in N-1). Month N only when the System Master parameter (read in the background) = allowed (not configured: no. 2; not allowed: no. 3). Past: no. 4; after N+1: no. 5 (TBD, OP-04).
5.2 Data Sources

rows: priceForPR: covers the month, not expired, unique; IDR / Km
Per operational month (per LP TBD, OP-02)
Orders per day per trucking company; defines the list (OP-11)

operation.text: 5.3 Calculation (revision 26-Nov-26)

items: Number of Orders (route, per day) = Order Sharing × Route % ÷ Σ active Route % (2 decimals). Total below 100%: split proportionally (TBD, OP-07).
Total Cost (route) = Planned Cost × Number of Orders (TBD, OP-14); the pop-up shows the sum in the Total Cost row.
Delivery Cost (IDR/Day) = Σ Total Cost of the routes.
Monthly Delivery Cost (IDR) = Delivery Cost (IDR/Day) × Working Days = PR amount of the trucking company (Fixed Cost not added, OP-16).
Example DNX, December 2026: 4 orders/day; route DPCMR_CYKRW 15% of 95% -> 0.63 orders; Planned Cost 57 × 2,700 = 153,900; Total Cost 96,957. Delivery Cost 432,405 / day × 22 = 9,512,910.

operation.text: 5.4 Status - Abnormality (PC-04, PC-05, PC-09)

The Status column shows only an abnormality of the detail (red): TMMIN Calendar missing (no. 6), no active Route Percentage (no. 7), no Order Sharing (no. 8) or Order Sharing = 0 (no. 9), Price per KM missing / expired / duplicated (no. 10), amount <= 0 (no. 11). Definition TBD (OP-12).

No abnormality: Status empty ('Ready' removed). All routes already in an active PR of the month: grey 'Already in PR {PR No}' (no. 12, OP-12); the trucking company is not in the new bundle. 'Created {PR No}' is not shown.
5.5 PR Sequence and Bundle (PC-06 to PC-08)

PR Sequence = MAX(PR_SEQ) of the operational month (all trucking companies, all statuses) + 1; the same sequence for every trucking company of the bundle; numbers are never reused. Each trucking company keeps its own PR number; sequence > 1 keeps the link to its first PR.

Components = one per route (ROUTE:{code}). Routes in PRs of the trucking company and month whose status is not Rejected / Returned are not created again; an additional bundle contains only the new routes.

rows: Rejected by DpH -> whole bundle back to PR Creation (sample data)

operation.text: 5.6 Submit PR - bundle (PC-10 to PC-12)

items: Submit PR: if not authorized message no. 14; before Create PR no. 20; any abnormality no. 15 (whole bundle blocked, OP-13); no trucking company with new routes no. 16.
Confirmation no. 17: operational month, PR Sequence, one line per trucking company (routes, amount), Total PR Cost, approval path and Current PIC.

Loading indicator; recalculate the bundle and re-check the sequence and the abnormalities in the same transaction (PC-11). Sequence taken meanwhile: no. 18; new abnormality: no. 15. Nothing is created (all-or-nothing, PC-12).
Insert the bundle header, one PR per trucking company, the routes, the approval levels and the history (Data Map). Message no. 19; the list is recalculated.
Approval levels from the workflow configuration; submitted by VPLD Staff: SH -> DpH -> DH; by VPLD Section Head: SH Skip (history note), starts at DpH. Current PIC = submitter.

operation.text: 5.7 PR Detail Pop-up (read only)

No header information. Table: Route, Route Percentage, Number of Orders, Distance, Planned Cost, then the Total Cost row (= Delivery Cost IDR/Day). Data from Master Route Percentage. Sticky header / footer; scrolls.
Closed only with x at the top right; no Close / Confirm & Create PR buttons.
5.8 Export
List Summary (.xls) and Route Plan Detail (.xls) of the filtered rows (no. 21); before Create PR: no. 20.
5.9 After Submission

The PRs appear in PR Approval / PR Inquiry (Production Month MM/YYYY-seq, sub text "Bundle · n PR"). Approve / reject applies to the whole bundle (no partial approval); a reject returns every PR of the bundle (OP-15).
PO creation per trucking company and auto approval follow the existing workflow (monthly-pr-po-rules.md).
5.10 Open Points of the revision 26-Nov-26 (default assumption used in this UISS)

rows: Without PR Creation Type: does one Submit PR create the Fixed Cost and the Route-Based PR together, or is the Fixed Cost no longer created by this screen?
The screen creates the route-based PR only; Fixed Cost is not created here (TBD where). The list shows the trucking companies paid By Resources (Master KPI).
Definition of the abnormality that fills the Status column and its text. Are "Created {PR No}" / "already in an earlier PR" still shown?
Abnormality = missing TMMIN Calendar, Route Percentage, Order Sharing (or 0), Price per KM, or amount <= 0 (message text). "Created" is not shown; grey "Already in PR {PR No}" is kept.
Submit PR when one trucking company is abnormal: block the whole bundle or not?
Blocked: Submit PR is disabled (message no. 15) until every abnormality is corrected.
Total Cost per route: Planned Cost x Number of Orders, or Planned Cost only?
Planned Cost x Number of Orders, with Number of Orders per day (Order Sharing x Route % / total active Route %), so that the sum is the Delivery Cost (IDR/Day).
Reject / Return of a bundle: where do the trucking companies go back to, and does the next Submit PR use a new PR Sequence?

A reject at any level rejects every PR of the bundle and returns them to PR Creation; the next Submit PR uses a new sequence (numbers are never reused). A PO rejected by GA still returns its own PR only.
Is the Fixed Cost still shown in the List Summary, now that the Monthly Delivery Cost does not add it?
Shown as information only (column can be hidden with Column).
